purpose: Design of document search and DLID resolution: pre-search freshness judgment, search result contract, semantic search by a read-only search AI, and resolve-dlid behavior.
summary: Pre-search judgment of confirmed ToC: rebuild unnecessary, necessary, or undeterminable
When rebuild is needed the user chooses rebuild then search or search the existing version, shown with rebuild scale counts
Undeterminable results stop the search as a failure and never fall back to the old version
Search result candidates carry document ID, recorded path, reason, section, key, ToC version and freshness
Search AI reads all entries of a ToC copy and prefers avoiding misses over precision
ToC copy contents: document information and section headings, no paths, hashes, references or check results
Search workers never invent IDs, correct paths or modify ToC and management state
resolve-dlid resolves each DLID from recorded paths and current files without a key
Resolution outcomes: resolved with path, anchor and hash, not at recorded path, or no record
tasks: Implementing search or pre-search freshness check
Designing the search AI agent and its input copy
Writing tests for search and DLID resolution
Handling stale ToC or undeterminable cases
title: DES-006 文書検索設計
